descriptor: Define artificial intelligence and distinguish it from ordinary computer programs.
Identify examples of artificial intelligence in everyday technology and explain how they are used.
Describe the difference between narrow AI and general AI.
Explain that machine learning systems learn patterns from data rather than following written rules.
Describe the role of training data in the accuracy of an AI system.
Sequence the stages of a simple machine learning workflow.
Recognise that AI systems can be biased and explain how biased data causes unfair outcomes.
Discuss responsible and safe use of AI tools, including privacy of personal data.
Use an AI tool to complete a defined task and evaluate the quality of its output.
Refine an instruction or prompt to improve the result an AI tool produces.
